theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_kernel_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ m, 0 < ε m ∧ ε m ≤ 1) → (∀ m, Antitone (φ m)) → (∀ m t, t ≤ 1 → φ m t = 1) → (∀ m t, 1 + ε m ≤ t → φ m t = 0) → (∀ m s, 0 < s → (φ m (s / ρ) - φ m (s / σ)) / s ^ n ≤ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n ∧ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n ≤ (1 + ε m) ^ n * ((φ m (s / ρ) - φ m (s / σ)) / s ^ n)) → (∀ m, Measurable (fun s ↦ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n)) ∧ (∀ m s, 0 ≤ s → |∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n| ≤ 2 ^ n / σ ^ n) ∧ (∀ m s, (1 + ε m) * ρ < s → ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n = 0) ∧ (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → Tendsto (fun m ↦ ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(s / τ ^ 2) * deriv (φ m) (s / τ) / τ ^ n) atTop (𝓝 ((Ioc σ ρ).indicator (fun s ↦ (s ^ n)⁻¹) s)))
